fields.title: 📖 Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī: our way is holding to the āthār
fields.body:
🖋️ **Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī** said:

> ***“Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī said, together with Abū Zurʿah: Our way and our choice is following the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, his Companions and the Tābiʿīn after them, and holding to the paths of the people of the āthār.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ahl as-Sunnah is not an empty name. It is attachment to the Messenger ﷺ, his Ṣaḥābah, the Tābiʿīn and the transmitted āthār.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Lālakāʾī, Sharḥ Uṣūl Iʿtiqād Ahl as-Sunnah, Iʿtiqād Abī Zurʿah wa Abī Ḥātim.
